name: knowledge-layer
observations: Local-first knowledge layer for game design documents
Stack: Bun, TypeScript, Orama (BM25 search), Zod schemas
Pipeline: Parse (PDF/DOCX/MD/TXT/CSV/JSON/YAML) → Structure (DocumentStructureNode) → Chunk (500 token BM25-optimized) → Index (Orama) → Search (lexical BM25)
Extraction: Rule-based only (GameMechanics, Economy schemas) - hard-coded keyword/regex matchers
No Knowledge Graph layer - flat chunk-based search only
No semantic/embedding search - lexical BM25 only

name: mirofish-patterns
observations: MiroFish (44k+ stars) - Swarm Intelligence Engine with Knowledge Graph backbone
Key pattern: LLM-as-Schema-Designer (dynamic ontology generation from text)
Key pattern: InsightForge (query decomposition → multi-pass search → entity tracking → relationship chains)
Key pattern: Batch+Queue+Buffer for high-throughput knowledge ingestion
Key pattern: Activity→NL→Graph for converting unstructured actions to graph updates
Key pattern: Graceful Degradation (API fail → local fallback)
Key pattern: Panorama Search (full picture including historical/expired content)
Uses Zep Cloud for graph storage and memory - NOT local-first
